mapper.select: SELECT level, max_spending AS maxSpending, reward_coin AS rewardCoin FROM challenge_levels ORDER BY max_spending ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_challenges (daily_living_cost_id, achieved_level_id, closed_at) SELECT dlc.id, (SELECT cl.id FROM challenge_levels cl WHERE cl.max_spending >= dlc.total_amount ORDER BY cl.max_spending ASC LIMIT 1) AS achieved_level_id, #{closedAt} FROM daily_living_costs dlc WHERE dlc.spending_date < #{today} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM daily_challenges dc WHERE dc.daily_living_cost_id = dlc.id )
mapper.select: SELECT dlc.user_id AS userId, cl.reward_coin AS rewardCoin FROM daily_challenges dc JOIN daily_living_costs dlc ON dlc.id = dc.daily_living_cost_id JOIN challenge_levels cl ON cl.id = dc.achieved_level_id WHERE dc.closed_at = #{closedAt}

SELECT dlc.spending_date AS challengeDate, cl.level AS achievedLevel, cl.reward_coin AS rewardCoin FROM daily_challenges dc JOIN daily_living_costs dlc ON dlc.id = dc.daily_living_cost_id LEFT JOIN challenge_levels cl ON cl.id = dc.achieved_level_id WHERE dlc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY dlc.spending_date DESC LIMIT 1
